headline: Approved signage for Notre Dame Cristo Rey High School at 203 Lawrence Street and roofing changes and railing update for 16 Ditson
summary: The commission approved a Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior banners and signage at 203 Lawrence Street #26-10. It also approved a Certificate of Non-Applicability for roofing work at 203 Lawrence Street #26-08 with conditions, and approved a railing update at 16 Ditson.
decisions: Approved the application for exterior decorative banners and new signage at 203 Lawrence Street #26-10 by a vote of 3 yes to 1 no.
Approved the Certificate of Non-Applicability for roofing work at 203 Lawrence Street #26-08 with conditions, unanimously.
Approved the railing update application at 16 Ditson, unanimously.

plain_text:
1 
 METHUEN HISTORIC DISTRICT COMMISSION 
 
Thursday, July23, 2026 @ 7:06 pm 
Sanborn Hall 
90 Hampshire Street  
Methuen, MA  01844 
 
1) Call to order 
Chair Moore called the meeting to order at 7:06 pm, noting the presence of a quorum. 
2) Roll Call 
    
Dianne Moore,  Chair Present   
Thomas Lussier Present   
John Hadley  Present   
Joseph Bella Present   
 
Others in attendance: Casey Dowgiert i3 Architects, PLLC  
Diane Moore was virtual and granted  Commissioner Lussier to be chairman for the meeting and 
to have signage approval for her upon the vote.  
 
3) Acceptance of Meeting Minutes: Commissioner Bella moves to approve meeting minutes for July. 
Commissioner Hadley second the motion. Unanimous affirmative vote. 7:07pm 
 
4) New Business: 
 
a. PUBLIC HEARINGS:  
 
i. 203 Lawrence Street #26-10: Chairman Moore opens the meeting to the applicant @7:01pm for the 
Certificate of Appropriateness for exterior decorative banners and new signage on  the façade of 
the building :  
Sister Maryalyce Gilfeather and Amy Hitchmoth of Notre Dame Cristo Rey High School and their contractor 
James Rousseau of N. Boston Contracting explained the proposed signage along the wall and building. 
Commissioner Lussier inquiries about scale of signage on building; referencing materials brough to meeting. 
Sister Maryalyce says instead of the letters it will spell it out on the building one on underneath each other and 
the text will be smaller.  Commissioner Hadley asks size of letters and attachment.  The applicant states they are 
attached to brick, and the text will be centered and will be blue in color to match the banners.   The letters are 
hoping to be reused from the old building.  Commissioner asks  for  placement, size and how its located on the 
building, and material.  Chairman Moore asks about the width of the building that the signage is being located 
on.  
 
Commissioner Lussier opened the meeting for public comment. He asked for comments in favor of the 
Certificate of Appropriateness, noting the applicant. He then asked for comments in opposition. Seeing 
and hearing none, he closed the public hearing at 7:20p.m. and opened discussion among Commission 
members.  
 
MOTION by Commissioner Moore to approve the application as is.  
Commissioner Bella  seconds the motion. It’s a 3 yes and Commissioner Hadley no so  the 
application is approved  @ 7:22pm.
2 
 
 
 
 
 
 
5) Old Business 
a) PUBLIC HEARINGS:   
 
i. 203 Lawrence Street #26-08: Chairman Moore opens the meeting to the applicant @7:25pm for the 
Certificate of Non-Applicability:  
James Rousseau of N. Boston Contracting explained the proposed roofing work. Exhibit C would replace 
with the  CertainTeed  Grand Mano Black Pear. 
Commissioner Hadley asked whether the applicant had considered composite material as a slate replacement. 
Chairman Moore asked about the age of the slate . The applicant says its beyond its lifetime of over 80 years 
of age.  Chairman Moore asks about the colors of the other roofs.  The Exhibit roof color hasn’t been 
selected as they would like to match the color.   
Commissioner Hadley researched the different options of asphalt, composite and slate after previous 
meeting and updates the commission that slate is very expensive, composite they are stating its 80 
years compared to 30-50 years for asphalt shingles.  Contractor states that hasn’t been  proven yet, 
however  they have 50 year warranty on their preferred product.  Discussion regarding colors as the 
black pearl is very dark.  Commissioner Hadley asks if there are examples of this  material in the 
district.   
The applicant  wants to amend Exhibit  B to match Exhibit C.    
Designer Slate Color: Stonegate Gray  
MOTION by Commissioner Bella  to approve the application with the following conditions.  
• Approve application portions exhibit B &C and table.    
• The light fixtures are to be submitted to the historic planner for review  
• Signage package to be submitted separately.  
 
Commissioner Moore  seconds the motion. It’s a UNANIMOUS AFFIRMATIVE VOTE @ 
7:41pm.   
 
 
ii. 16 Ditson : 7:44pm 
 
The applicant describes the proposed railing update from previous from architect. Commissioner Hadley 
asks about view from the street and driveway and discussion that this is the only option for meeting 
accessibility. Casey Dowgiert mentions concerns for ADA to be reviewed with building department and 
applicant.   
MOTION by Commissioner Bella to approve the application.  
It’s a UNANIMOUS AFFIRMATIVE VOTE @ 8:04pm.   
 
 
6) Other Business 
• Noted that violations need to be updated and enforcement letters to be sent out. 
• Searles Estate updates to the commission.  
 
7) Adjournment: 
MOTION to adjourn by Commissioner Lussier. Seconded by Commissioner Bella. UNANIMOUS 
AFFIRMATIVE VOTE. Meeting Adjourned at 8:37
